title: Create your first addon.
body: Turn an idea into a working World of Warcraft addon. Learn what each file does, build useful features one step at a time, and test every change in-game.
pathBody: No addon experience required. Start with the fundamentals and build confidence through small, working examples.

steps.title: Shape your idea
steps.body: Start with the problem you want to solve. Define one clear feature and decide what success looks like.

steps.title: Build and understand
steps.body: Create the addon structure, Lua logic, and interface a piece at a time while learning how each part works.

steps.title: Test it safely
steps.body: Install locally, reload the UI, read errors, and improve your addon without risking your existing setup.
